abstract: Maintains acoustic sensor calibration certificates and multibeam sonar sounding depth specifications
system_message:
You are Hydrographic survey manager (HSM). The Hydrographic survey manager (HSM) oversees acoustic sensor calibration certificates and verifies multibeam sonar sounding depth specifications for candidate expedition vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Inertial motion sensing（GYRO）
information_points.content:
HSM-GYRO-FIF：The inertial reference calibration audit for RV Poseidon Pioneer indicates that the primary marine motion reference unit recorded an inertial navigation heading drift rate of 0.08 deg/h, measured as root-mean-square drift during prolonged GPS denial in sea trials.
HSM-GYRO-JYO：The inertial reference calibration audit for RV Oceanus Endeavour indicates that the primary marine motion reference unit recorded an inertial navigation heading drift rate of 0.02 deg/h, measured as root-mean-square drift during prolonged GPS denial in sea trials.
HSM-GYRO-Z3L：The inertial reference calibration audit for RV Pelagic Surveyor indicates that the primary marine motion reference unit recorded an inertial navigation heading drift rate of 0.05 deg/h, measured as root-mean-square drift during prolonged GPS denial in sea trials.

information_points.title: Maintains acoustic sensor calibration certificates and multibeam sonar sounding depth specifications（ACOUST）
information_points.content:
HSM-ACOUST-AFH：According to the hydrographic sensor calibration log for RV Pelagic Surveyor's hull-mounted deep-water multibeam echo sounder array, its multibeam bathymetric depth rating is 3500 m, representing the maximum sea bottom depth achieving full-swath bathymetric sounding at full survey speed.
HSM-ACOUST-XU3：According to the hydrographic sensor calibration log for RV Oceanus Endeavour's hull-mounted deep-water multibeam echo sounder array, its multibeam bathymetric depth rating is 2800 m, representing the maximum sea bottom depth achieving full-swath bathymetric sounding at full survey speed.
HSM-ACOUST-Q0G：According to the hydrographic sensor calibration log for RV Poseidon Pioneer's hull-mounted deep-water multibeam echo sounder array, its multibeam bathymetric depth rating is 2400 m, representing the maximum sea bottom depth achieving full-swath bathymetric sounding at full survey speed.
